def elevation_angle(location1: 'Location', location2: 'Location', radians:
    float=False) ->Optional[float]:
    if location1 is None or location2 is None:
        return None
    
    if location1.elevation is None or location2.elevation is None:
        return None
    
    distance_2d = location1.distance_2d(location2)
    if distance_2d is None or distance_2d == 0:
        return None
    
    elevation_diff = location2.elevation - location1.elevation
    
    angle_rad = mod_math.atan(elevation_diff / distance_2d)
    
    if radians:
        return angle_rad
    else:
        return mod_math.degrees(angle_rad)
